reading.rtitle: Performance Review · Patrícia Xavier Lima Iwashita · Written by Karen, Head of Customer Success
paras: This was the year when Patrícia stepped up. In January she managed a portfolio of mid-size accounts; since August she has managed our twelve premium accounts, and eleven of them have renewed. Although the second half of the year started with a difficult outage, her calls during the crisis became an example for the whole team. The Brightwave survey is the clearest evidence: their rating for support went from six to ten.

Her biggest breakthrough was in meetings. A year ago she spoke only when somebody asked her a question. This year she has run business reviews, exit interviews and budget calls in English, and customers now ask for her by name. There was one real setback: we lost Harbor Health in September. If we had talked to their finance team earlier, we would have kept them, and Patrícia turned that lesson into a new rule for the whole team.

Going forward, I would like her to step out of her comfort zone once more. Next year she will be onboarding two new team members, and by December she will have presented at our global customer conference. Her fluency is already strong; the next step is to keep up the practice, so that her confidence never depends on the day. Her promotion to Senior Customer Success Manager is well-deserved.
reading.source: Adapted for class use from an end-of-year performance review

listenings.text: Hi Patrícia, it is Karen. I just sent your performance review to Mark, and I wanted to say this by voice, not by email. When you joined my team, you told me that your biggest problem was confidence, not English. You said that you noticed your own mistakes, and that they made you quiet in meetings. This year I have watched you lead calls in the middle of an outage, answer a difficult survey, and tell a CFO the bottom line in one sentence. Your English is not perfect, and nobody's is. But your fluency is strong, and your confidence no longer depends on the day. Keep up the practice, and enjoy the promotion. You earned it.

Hi Patrícia, it is Daniel from Brightwave. Victor told me the news about your promotion, so congratulations from all of us. I want to tell you something that I did not say in the survey. When the sync failed in August, I was ready to look at other vendors. What changed my mind was not the fix. It was your call that same afternoon, when you said: I am not sure yet, but it can't be the server, and I will call you back by five. And you did. Next year we will be opening twenty new stores, and I want you in the kickoff, even if you are a senior manager now. See you in January.
